lesson_title: LESSON 07: Sharing the Road & Special Circumstances
topic_title: Transporting Cargo, Safety Chains & Towing Laws
prompt: When cargo extends more than 4 feet beyond the rear of a vehicle body, what marking is required?

options.text: A red flag at least 12 inches square by day, or a red lamp visible for 500 ft at night
A yellow reflective ribbon measuring three inches wide tied to trailer hitch
A handwritten cardboard warning placard attached to rear window wiper
Overhanging loads beyond four feet are strictly prohibited in Texas
